summary: Iteration 40 e2e testing of (1) subscription e-Archive invoice PDF endpoint, (2) one-click renew link (JWT) → RenewPage → Stripe checkout, (3) license reminders renew_link, (4) platform public_url setting, (5) invoice withholding math + status=draft vs approved balance behavior, (6) print-template hide_all_prices/hide_vat/hide_line_prices/show_item_notes/show_order_notes + Orders ⋮ overflow menu. Backend pytest: 9/9 PASS (100%) — GET /api/invoices/{sub_inv_id}/pdf returns application/pdf, %PDF magic, >10KB; 404 for unknown id. make_renew_token(comp_nexus_b2b_02, plan_standard) → GET /public/renew/{token} returns company.name, license, plan.name='Standart', 4 public plans, providers, catalog; bad token → 400. POST /public/renew/{token}/checkout with period=yearly + plan_id override plan_pro → Stripe checkout_url + session_id; /payments/status/{sid} → pending. Reminders: PUT /system/companies/comp_nexus_b2b_02/license {status:active, expires_at:+20h}; POST /system/reminders/run then GET /system/reminders → latest.result.renew_link=true; license restored to expires_at:null. PUT /system/settings public_url set+clear round-trip. Withholding invoice: subtotal=1000, vat_total=200, withholding_amount=100, grand_total=1100, status=draft leaves contact balance unchanged; same payload with status=approved increases balance by +1100. GET/PUT /companies/comp_nexus_main_01/print-templates/order persists hide_all_prices+show_order_notes then reverted. Frontend: /yenile/<token> renders renew-page + renew-summary 'Standart' with Turkish module labels; renew-plan-plan_pro → 'Profesyonel'; renew-billing-y switches to /yıl (14.990 ₺); renew-pay-stripe redirects to checkout.stripe.com (cs_test_...). Bad token → renew-error 'Bağlantı geçersiz'. Super admin /sistem/giris → /sistem/ayarlar shows set-public-url + set-save; save toast 'Platform ayarları kaydedildi' verified; cleared afterwards. ERP admin /orders: 33 order-more-btn-* buttons; menu opens with dispatch-btn-, return-order-btn-, cargo-label-btn-, print-order-btn-, notify-order-btn- present; no pre-open dispatch icons visible on row. /invoices Yeni Fatura modal: inv-etype-select value='paper' (default), inv-status-draft selected, save button text 'Taslak Olarak Kaydet'; inv-withholding-select contains '5/10 – Etüt, plan-proje, danışmanlık (602)' (value 0.5|602); inv-item-kind-0 toggles Ü→H and reveals inv-item-service-name-0; inv-price-mode-incl changes column header to 'Birim Fiyat (KDV Dahil)'; after entering 1000 TL price + selecting 602 withholding → totals show Ara Toplam 1.000, KDV 200, Tevkifat (5/10 KDV) -100, Ödenecek Tutar 1.100 TL and withholding-row selector present. /invoices print-inv-btn-* opens print-document with print-edit-template-btn; PrintTemplateEditor exposes tpl-hide_all_prices, tpl-hide_vat, tpl-hide_line_prices, tpl-show_item_notes, tpl-show_order_notes and tpl-save-btn; API persistence confirmed via GET /print-templates.

integration_issues.issue: InvoicesPage renders <PrintTemplateEditor .../> without an onSaved handler; PrintDocument fetches templates only on mount, so after saving hide_all_prices=true from within an already-open print preview, the same open preview does NOT re-render with hidden prices. User must close and reopen the print dialog. The underlying template persists correctly (verified via GET). Consider passing onSaved={setTplState} or forcing a refetch to update the open PrintDocument in place.

action_items: (Minor UX) Pass onSaved callback from InvoicesPage/OrdersPage to <PrintTemplateEditor/> so that the currently-open <PrintDocument/> refetches or receives the updated template and re-renders with hide_all_prices / hide_vat / hide_line_prices applied immediately without needing to close+reopen the preview.
critical_code_review_comments: saas_docs.build_invoice_pdf hard-codes 'Hesaplanan KDV (%20)' label; if a subscription plan ever changes VAT rate, the header will lie. Use inv['items'][0]['vat_rate'] or compute effective rate from vat_total/subtotal.

saas_docs.invoice_pdf endpoint has NO auth gating — anyone with an invoice_id (UUIDs though) can download the PDF. Consider gating with require_auth or at least a per-invoice signed token when linked from public email.

saas_docs.make_renew_token embeds pid inside JWT; user can freely override plan_id in POST /checkout body → any plan can be purchased. This is intentional per spec but confirm business rule: is it acceptable that a b2b_02 tenant with plan_standard token could pay for plan_enterprise? Currently yes.
PrintTemplateEditor.save() calls onClose() without informing the parent-rendered <PrintDocument/> — described in frontend integration_issues above.

server.create_invoice recomputes vat_total using pre-discount per-item factor but withholding_amount = vat_total * withholding_rate uses the full vat_total; consistent with test expectations (200*0.5=100) — OK.
server.py line 1414 uses count_documents to derive invoice_number sequence; concurrent creates could collide. Consider atomic $inc counter (as used for _next_number for 'IRS').

saas_billing.settings PUT_settings whitelists only a subset of keys; 'reminder_days' and 'currency' are read but not writable via PUT (require different key set). If admin edits reminder_days via UI, verify it goes through (not part of this iteration).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI selectors and flows verified; minor UX refresh issue noted)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test invoices under comp_nexus_main_01 (TEST_Danışmanlık hizmeti) — both deleted immediately in test cleanup; contact balance restored via PUT /contacts/{id}. 1 Stripe test session_id from renew-checkout persists (status=initiated, harmless). comp_nexus_b2b_02 license reset to {status:active, expires_at:null} after reminder test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PrintDocument does not auto-refresh after template save; testers should close print modal and reopen to verify template changes visually. Withholding UI: use inv-withholding-select value format '0.5|602'; UI shows 'withholding-row' + 'Ödenecek Tutar' only after items have a unit_price. Cari selector inside new-invoice modal is a custom Popover/Combobox (not <select>); Playwright cannot easily open it via click on placeholder text — API-level tests should be used for full create flow validation instead. Stripe hosted checkout completion not exercised (requires real card interaction).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Only a minor UX refresh gap on PrintTemplateEditor→PrintDocument (documented above).
